company: Demo Call with Larry Higdon from Everyday Health

calls.title: Demo Call with Larry Higdon from Everyday Health
calls.summary: The team is evaluating GrowthBook to potentially replace VWO, driven by the need for better GA4 integration and cost savings. Larry Higdon discussed challenges with VWO regarding GA event wiring and credit management, and found GrowthBook's event-based pricing to be more suitable. The architecture supports self-hosting with a proxy layer, allowing for controlled project management. Features like safe rollouts, flexible targeting, and advanced analytics were highlighted, enabling better experiment management. The roadmap includes a trial of the enterprise version following an open source pilot, aiming to finalize a decision before the VWO contract expires in September.
calls.keywords: experimentation, GrowthBook, BigQuery integration, feature flags, product analytics, enterprise trial
calls.action_items:
**Larry Higdon**
Review GrowthBook premium versus open source features and consult internal technical teams to ensure alignment with Everyday Health's requirements (41:00)
Discuss internally the potential transition from VWO to GrowthBook enterprise after receiving detailed information (43:00)

**Scott Keller**
Provide detailed comparison information between GrowthBook open source and enterprise offerings, including licensing and pricing details (43:00)
Coordinate and propose a three-week GrowthBook enterprise trial following delivery of comparison information (43:00)

**GrowthBook Team**
Support Everyday Health in any proof of concept or testing of self-hosted configurations and proxy setup (25:00)
Assist with documentation and technical clarifications on integrating GrowthBook with BigQuery and GA4 data (12:00)
Provide follow-up support and answer additional questions as they arise during the evaluation phase (44:00)
